_comment: Build-time plugins we publish on npm, keyed by framework guide slug. Not generated: edit by hand when a plugin ships. Each snippet is lifted from the package README in packages/*-plugin, so the page cannot promise an option the plugin lacks.

plugins.summary: On astro build it writes sitemap.xml and robots.txt into the output unless public/ already provides them, then checks every built page and, with failOnError, fails the build on error-level issues. Astro 3 through 7.
A metadata generator for the App Router with a title template and canonical per path, plus sitemap and robots handlers for app/sitemap.ts and app/robots.ts. Next.js 13 through 16.
